assumptions.statement_zh: 官方总体边界、地籍和重点区 polygon 尚未作为本包输入；全部 geometry 为 provisional 工作模型，官方数据发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: Official boundary, cadastral and key-area polygons are not package inputs; all geometry is provisional and must be recalculated after official data release.

assumptions.statement_zh: 绿地蓝线、文保、消防、燃气、冷链、产权和建设控制条件未知；本包只保留概念关系，不给出审批或工程结论。
assumptions.statement_en: Green, heritage, fire, gas, cold-chain, property and statutory controls are unknown; this package gives relationships only and no approval or engineering conclusion.

assumptions.statement_zh: 「食链智证」「FoodChain JZ」「一桌一策」「三审三退」「谷粒公约」及节点名称均为内部工作代号，未完成在先权利检索，不作商标或品牌权利声明。
assumptions.statement_en: FoodChain JZ and all mechanism or node names are internal working codenames; no prior-rights search is complete and no trademark or brand-right claim is made.

assumptions.statement_zh: 所有面积、比例、节点和数量是参与者 provisional 工作模型，非权威统计；官方数据发布后按同一公式更新版本。
assumptions.statement_en: All areas, ratios, nodes and counts are participant provisional working values, not authoritative statistics; update by the same formulas after official data release.

assumptions.statement_zh: 三区三厨房、两翼两市场和食育慢行回路是可撤的空间—产业概念结构；厨房、市场和接口不等同于已许可工程。
assumptions.statement_en: The three districts, three kitchens, two wings, two markets and learning loop are reversible spatial-industry concepts; kitchens, markets and interfaces are not approved works.

assumptions.statement_zh: AI 治理坚持仅匿名聚合、关键决策人工复核、禁止过度监控；不采集人脸、声纹、车牌、精细轨迹、个体消费画像或敏感健康信息。
assumptions.statement_en: AI governance is limited to anonymous aggregation, human review for key decisions and no excessive surveillance; no faces, voices, plates, fine routes, individual purchase profiles or sensitive health data.

assumptions.statement_zh: 月度开发者诊所、季度一桌一策共创、年度食链智证公开日和年度公示均为建议性运营安排，不代表官方活动或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: Monthly developer clinics, quarterly co-design, the annual FoodChain Evidence day and annual notice are suggested operations, not official events or investment commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 12 项运营指标没有现状或试点基线；样本、分母、阈值、记录责任人和复核周期须在试点章程中由运营方与公众共同确认，当前均为 unknown/to_verify。
assumptions.statement_en: The 12 operational metrics have no current or pilot baseline; sample, denominator, threshold, owner and review cadence must be confirmed in a pilot charter with operators and the public, and remain unknown/to_verify for now.
